opening.argument: The video shows the construction and operation of a portable retro game console that can also serve as a Windows 10 tablet. The speaker invites viewers to rebuild the device at home, describes programming its gamepad controls with an Arduino joystick library, and reports that it works when powered by a power bank. A handheld display visibly shows a retro game running. The JLCPCB promotion is disclosed as a sponsorship for a PCB service offering low prices. It sits within a hands-on electronics tutorial, with no investment, credential, or victim-payment scheme identified in the cited material.

citations.quote: In this project I will show you how to create a portable retro game console that can also be used as a Windows 10 tablet.
So sit back and enjoy the journey of me creating this device so that you can easily rebuild it at home.
I installed the Arduino joystick library And used it to write a bit of code which maps the different pins of the Atmega I see to a button of the gamepad
